name: stacks
description: The stack packs: the dependency graph read from source, scaffolds, reference slices, event types and compile errors (docs/design/stack-packs.md).

messages.contractEvent: event type {{type}} is not <Org>.<Service>.<Noun><PastTenseVerb> with no version suffix
messages.packNone: no stack pack fits this project; the packs look for: {{detect}}
messages.graphSelftest: the project's graph ({{command}}) lacks {{count}} edges the stack pack reads from source, e.g. {{edges}}
messages.sliceImport: slice {{from}} imports slice {{to}}: slices meet only through interfaces, events or shared domain services
messages.sliceEntry: {{from}} imports slice {{slice}}, which only its domain's {{layers}} layer or a {{kinds}} module may enter
messages.sliceUnreached: slice {{slice}} is entered from nowhere: no {{layers}} layer or {{kinds}} module imports it
messages.slicePlace: {{file}} sits in no layer of domain {{domain}} ({{layers}})
messages.sliceLoose: {{file}} sits in {{application}} but in no slice folder
messages.sliceSurfaceFolder: a folder but not a command or query under # Surface
messages.sliceSurfaceDoc: a command or query under # Surface but not a folder
messages.sliceUseCase: domain {{domain}}: slice {{slice}} names no use case: {{text}}
messages.sliceNoStory: domain {{domain}}: slice {{slice}} cites no story as [I-<n>:US<g>.<s>]
messages.sliceBadStory: domain {{domain}}: slice {{slice}} cites {{story}}, which no intent holds
messages.sliceUncovered: domain {{domain}}: no slice cites {{story}}, a story of {{intent}}'s unit of work that changes it
messages.sliceTest: slice {{slice}} has no test: none in its folder and none importing it
messages.cardReference: Copy the shape of the stack pack's reference domain ({{domain}}): the command slice {{command}} and the query slice {{query}}.
messages.sliceName: slice {{slice}} of domain {{domain}} is no name the registry composes from a verb and the domain's noun: {{names}}
messages.sliceRouteTwice: operation id {{id}} is used twice in the contracts
messages.sliceRouteNone: operation id {{id}} maps to slice {{slice}} of {{domain}}, which has no folder
messages.sliceRouteUnknown: operation id {{id}} maps to no domain and verb of the registry
messages.sliceNoRoute: slice {{slice}} has no operation in the contracts, though its domain {{domain}} is served there
messages.sliceDeliverRoute: the bolt adds slice {{slice}} but changes nothing in {{layers}} or a runtime that wires its route
messages.valueLiteral: {{path}}:{{line}} adds the literal {{value}} to code: values live in the project's data
messages.sliceDeliverListed: {{unit}} lists slice {{slice}} but changes nothing in its folder
messages.planSliceBind: {{unit}} lists slices but binds no one domain: a horizontal bolt delivers no slice
messages.planSliceSurface: {{unit}} lists slice {{slice}}, which the {{domain}} domain doc's # Surface does not list
messages.sliceDeliverDoc: the bolt adds slice {{slice}} but does not change {{doc}}, which lists it
messages.sliceNoCuts: slice {{slice}} does not say which layers it cuts: from method 13 it reads <Kind> <slice> (<cut>, …; data …; entry …)
messages.sliceUnknownCut: slice {{slice}} cuts {{cut}}, a layer the stack pack does not have (it has {{cuts}})
messages.slicePartUnknown: slice {{slice}} declares {{part}}, which is no part of a slice's declaration ({{parts}})
messages.sliceDataOwner: slice {{slice}} uses {{node}}, which {{domain}} neither owns nor shares
messages.sliceEntryRuntime: slice {{slice}} is served by {{entry}}, which is no runtime module
messages.slicePermission: slice {{slice}} needs permission {{permission}}, which the registry composes for none of its domains ({{names}})
messages.sliceEmits: slice {{slice}} emits {{event}}, which {{domain}}'s # Surface lists on no Events line
messages.sliceConsumes: slice {{slice}} consumes {{event}}, which no domain's # Surface lists on an Events line
messages.sliceCalls: slice {{slice}} calls {{target}}, which is no domain, extension or adapter module
messages.sliceUi: slice {{slice}} serves a ui unit of work but does not cut ui, which the stack pack has

GRAPH-SELFTEST.fix: make the project's architecture.graph print every import and data edge, or set it to the plugin's: node .aidlc/bin/aidlc.mjs graph (docs: Stack packs)

commands.name: graph
commands.does: print the dependency graph the stack pack reads from source: imports and data edges

commands.name: scaffold
commands.does: write a kind's templates from the stack pack, named from the registry; never overwrites

PLAN-SLICE.fix: list under slices only the vertical slices the bolt delivers, each a Command or Query line of its bound domain's # Surface; a bolt that binds a horizontal module lists none (docs: Vertical slices checked)

VALUE-LITERAL.fix: move the value into the project's data files (the profile's values.data globs) and read it from there; list it in values.allow when it is the protocol of a tool the code calls (docs: Values as data)

SLICE-IMPORT.fix: move what both slices need into the domain's model, an event or a shared domain service; a slice never imports another (docs: Vertical slices checked)

SLICE-ENTRY.fix: enter the slice from its domain's interface layer or from the runtime that hosts it, and only from there (docs: Vertical slices checked)

SLICE-PLACE.fix: put each file of a domain in one of its layers, each file of its application layer in one slice folder, and leave no folder empty (docs: Vertical slices checked)

SLICE-SURFACE.fix: list each slice folder under the domain doc's # Surface as - Command <slice>: <the use case it serves> [I-<n>:US<g>.<s>], or - Query, and no other (docs: Vertical slices checked)

SLICE-STORY.fix: cite on each slice's surface line the stories it serves, as [I-<n>:US<g>.<s>], so every story of a unit of work that changes the domain has a slice (docs: Vertical slices checked)

SLICE-TEST.fix: give the slice a test in its folder, or a test that imports it (docs: Vertical slices checked)

SLICE-NAME.fix: name the slice as aidlc name slice composes it, from a verb of the registry and the domain's noun (docs: Vertical slices checked)

SLICE-ROUTE.fix: give each slice its operation, with the operation id aidlc name operation-id composes from the same domain and verb, once in the contracts (docs: Vertical slices checked)

SLICE-DELIVER.fix: deliver a new slice whole: its route in the domain's interface layer or a runtime, its test and its line under the domain doc's # Surface, in the same bolt (docs: Vertical slices checked)
